description: This Kotlin source file contains a fake implementation of the RecentSearchRepository used for testing purposes in the Android app. It provides dummy methods for inserting, retrieving, and clearing recent search queries.

classes.name: FakeRecentSearchRepository
classes.description: A mock implementation of RecentSearchRepository for testing that does not persist data and returns empty results.

methods.name: insertOrReplaceRecentSearch
methods.description: Suspends and performs no operation, simulating insertion or replacement of a search query.

methods.name: getRecentSearchQueries
methods.description: Returns a Flow emitting an empty list of RecentSearchQuery objects.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Suspends and performs no operation, simulating the clearing of recent searches.
